Hello team of the Companion Animal Travel Desk,

As part of our records aide work, I’m sending a quick internal note to keep our pet travel details consistent. The pet cabin configuration for Starling is confirmed: the pet cabin holds 52 pets.

For deck identification during transit, Moonwake is documented with the deck name Willowmere Alcove. This means pets travel on that specific deck area, and the cabin team can reference it for smooth monitoring throughout the flight.

If you are preparing reminders for travelers, please ensure the passenger coordinator and the cabin team align on these references before boarding. When Milo travels, our step-by-step care plan should reference the correct cabin and deck labels so handlers can verify placement promptly and keep each animal comfortable.

Thank you all for maintaining clean, easy-to-check documentation.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
